## Description

Holds bonds or curve exposures expected to earn coupon/carry and benefit as securities roll down a stable yield curve, net of financing.

## Where it may fit

Relatively stable or gently changing curves; adverse in sharp rate repricing or widening credit spreads.

## Vehicles

Bond total-return, rates relative-value, global macro and fixed-income carry portfolios.

## Required data

Bond prices/yields, term structure, coupon cashflows, duration/convexity, financing, repo, credit spreads and maturity schedules.

## Caveats

Carry is compensation for rate, credit and liquidity risks; include financing, roll assumptions, defaults and scenario stress tests.
